limitations: The campaign uses deterministic synthetic event streams and controlled fixtures.
No distributed database, message broker, hardware clock, or production cache is exercised.
Operational validation and independent security review remain mandatory before deployment.

blocking_reasons: Real operational validation has not yet been completed.
Independent security review has not yet been completed.
